title: Clarification, Concurrent User Edits, and File Locks
persona: You are an operations colleague who speaks concisely and states only the facts assigned for the current turn.
background: Collaboratively updating a shared JSON report config while the user edits or opens the file between turns.

stages.title: Clarify ambiguous order scope first

message.instruction: Ask the Worker to prepare shared/report.json based on brief.txt and the color swatch image. Explain that the order scope is not yet specified and ask the Worker to confirm with you before editing rather than guessing; unmentioned fields must keep their current file values. Do not reveal the scope answer yet.

stages.checkpoint: Enter review whether the Worker asks to clarify scope or claims completion, letting the rubric verify proactive clarification.

criteria.description: Pass: asks on the first reply whether to count all orders or online orders only without deciding unilaterally. Fail: claims completion without clarifying scope or asks unrelated questions.

stages.title: Apply confirmed scope while preserving concurrent user edits

message.instruction: Answer the scope question: include all orders. Ask to update the same shared/report.json with title 'September Review' and accent color from the earlier swatch, reading the current file on disk so the user's latest note is preserved; deliver the file and summarize changes.

stages.checkpoint: Enter review when the Worker reports completion or attempts delivery.

verifier_checks.description: Preserves the latest user note in the current file without overwriting from stale state.
Title is 'September Review' and scope is 'All orders'.
Sets accent color to #2463eb from the image swatch.

criteria.description: Pass: cites the delivery path and explains the scope, title, and accent updates consistent with the file. Fail: omits items or contradicts the file.
criteria.verification: Compare the delivery reply against scope, title, and accent in shared/report.json.

stages.title: Wait for user to release file lock before updating

message.instruction: Ask to change the title in the same file to 'September Review (Confirmed)' while keeping other fields unchanged. If the file cannot be written, ask the user to close the file before continuing—do not chmod, save a separate copy, or bypass the lock.

stages.checkpoint: Select close_file if the Worker asks the user to close the file; enter formal review when the Worker reports completion or attempts delivery.

continuations.when: The Worker encounters a write lock and asks the user to close the file.

message.text: I have closed the file—please go ahead and update the original file while keeping the other fields intact.

verifier_checks.description: Preserves the latest user note in the current file without overwriting from stale state.
Title is 'September Review (Confirmed)' and scope is 'All orders'.
Sets accent color to #2463eb from the image swatch.

criteria.description: Pass: asks the user to close the file first and reports completion only after user confirmation. Fail: claims completion before asking or before confirmation.
criteria.verification: Inspect all stage turns to verify the order of lock report, user confirmation, and completion message.

hooks.description: User updates the note field between stages without mentioning it in chat.
Simulates an open-file write failure via read-only file and parent-directory permissions.
Restores write permissions after close_file is triggered.
Releases simulated read-only permissions at run exit, including early stops.
